26" Fat Tire 7-Speed Beach Cruiser Bike with Disc Brakes
Micargi 26 Seattle SS Complete Cruiser Bikes Shimano 7-Speed high Rise Handlebars Fat Tires DISC Braking Adult Beach Bike
Welcome to explore the Micargi 26 Seattle SS Complete Cruiser Bike - an all-terrain wonder designed to provide an unparalleled riding experience. Equipped with a sturdy Tracer Stretch STEEL frame with rack mount and disc braking, this bike ensures stability and reliability during your adventures. The Tracer Triple Tree Fork with aluminum cover guarantees your safety on the road.
Presented in a stylish Matte Black color and available in XL size, this bike showcases both personality and taste. The Tracer Steel Hi-Rise handlebar (15" wide, 31.5" high) and aluminum heavy-duty threadless stem offer a comfortable grip and steady control.
The steel seatpost (28.6x200) ensures durability and dependability. The vacuum elastic PVC leather saddle with high-density PU foam guarantees a comfortable ride during long journeys. The one-piece PP pedals make riding effortless.
For smooth and precise shifting, the bike features Shimano RS35-7 shifters and a Shimano TY300 7-Speed rear derailleur. The Disc 160mm brakes with aluminum brake levers ensure your safety on the road. The Shimano TZ500 11-28T cassette and KMC C80 chain provide versatile riding options.
The aluminum/steel 46T crankset and integrated seal 2PC bottom bracket enhance the bike's stability and durability. The Tracer T75 W/800mm aluminum disc wheelset, paired with Tracer HB26 36H*14G hubs and #45 Steel 14G spokes, ensure robustness and resilience.
With 26x4.0 fat tires and inner tubes, this bike offers excellent traction and cushioning, making it perfect for conquering various terrains. The Micargi 26 Seattle SS Complete Cruiser Bike combines comfort, functionality, and durability, making it an excellent choice for leisurely beach rides. Grab yours now and embark on an exciting cycling journey!
